Road conditions

  • (414)785-7140/ (800)762-3947-Road conditions
  • http://www.dot.wisconsin.gov/travel/road/workzones.htm (Road construction map)
  • http://www.dot.wisconsin.gov/travel/road/winter-roads.htm#map (Road conditions map/ chart)

When Permit Is Needed

  • Over 8'6" wide, over 13'6" high, trailer over 40' long, over 80,000 lbs.

Special Information Needed

  • Load info, load dimensions broken down
  • Times Of Movement-See provision sheet MV2605-394 or cal (608)266-7320
  • Sunrise to sunset; M-F & Sat. until noon
  • Nighttime travel is permitted for loads not exceeding 100' long,12' wide, & 13’6” high; loads less than this allowed to travel all weekend from Memorial Day to Labor Day
  • Loads exceeding the previous size may not travel from sunset to sunrise; after 4pm on Friday from the 4th Friday in May and Labor Day; during the period beginning at noon on the day preceding every holiday and continuing until sunrise the day following every holiday
  • Over 15’ high w/ reflectorized striped hazard markers on outside extremities of load.
  • Holidays w/ restricted travel times: New Years Day, Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas

Weekend travel:

  • Loads over 100' long, 12' wide, 13'6" high travel only until noon on Sat.
  • Loads less than these dimensions may travel

When Pilot/Escort Vehicle is Required

  • http://www.legis.state.wi.us/rsb/code/trans/trans252.pdf

On 2-way, 2-lane highways:

  • When any part of the load or vehicle extends beyond the left of roadway centerline-1 pilot
  • Width over 15' up to 16' (frequently)-1 front
  • On any highway designated by permit-1 or more
  • Width over 16'-2 (front & rear)
  • Over 125' long-2 (front & rear)

On multi-lane highways:

  • Same as 2- lane except when any part of vehicle/load extends beyond the left of the right hand lane.

Mobiles:

  • Width over 14' (on certain highways) - 1 pilot car
  • Width over 16’-police/private escort: 1 rear on divided highways; 1 front & 1 rear on non-divided highways

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle

  • “OVERSIZE LOAD” sign mounted above the roof of the vehicle
  • Sign must measure 5’ x 12” w/ black letters 10” high (brush stroke width of not less than 1 ½”) on a solid yellow/amber background
  • Bright red or orange flag at least 18” square
  • 2 bright red or orange flags at least 18” square on a short staff mounted on the front bumper (one on each side)
  • 2 amber warning lights mounted on or above the vehicle roof; it shall include a single or multiple pulse strobe light and shall flash, pulse or rotate between 30 & 120 times/minute; shall be visible at a distance of 500’ & 360o circumference

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle Operator

  • Must be at least 18 years of age
  • Must have an operator’s license issued to the vehicle operator and valid in Wisconsin
  • A non-resident must have a license or certification issued in another jurisdiction that allows that person to operate a pilot car in that jurisdiction
